```php
// fasta benchmark — exact reproduction of the Benchmarks Game "fasta" output.
//
// The LCG  seed = (seed*3877 + 29573) mod 139968  has full period 139968
// (Hull–Dobell theorem: 139968 = 2^6*3^7; 3877-1 = 2^2*3*17*19 is divisible by
// 2, 3 and 4; gcd(29573, 139968) = 1).  The stream of drawn values is therefore
// purely periodic with period 139968, so the symbol stream of each random
// section is periodic too.  We run the real generator for exactly one period
// per table (bit-exact by construction) and then materialise the long
// sequences by repeating that period — identical output, O(1) work per char.

error_reporting(E_ALL);
ini_set('display_errors', 'stderr');

$IM = 139968;
$IA = 3877;
$IC = 29573;

$n = (int)($argv[1] ?? 0);

/**
 * Build one full period (139968 symbols) of the random stream for the given
 * frequency table, continuing the shared LCG state $seed. The per-draw
 * selection is exactly the reference rule: advance the seed, take
 * r = seed/139968, output the first symbol whose running cumulative
 * probability is strictly greater than r.
 */
function makePeriod(array $chars, array $probs, int &$seed, int $IM, int $IA, int $IC): string
{
    // running cumulative probabilities (same double arithmetic as reference)
    $cum = array();
    $c = 0.0;
    foreach ($probs as $p) { $c += $p; $cum[] = $c; }
    $nSym = count($chars);
    $last = $nSym - 1;

    // symbol for every possible seed value (r = v/IM increases with v, so the
    // selected index only moves forward)
    $map = str_repeat('?', $IM);
    $p = 0;
    for ($v = 0; $v < $IM; $v++) {
        $r = $v / $IM;
        while ($p < $last && $cum[$p] <= $r) $p++;
        $map[$v] = $chars[$p];
    }

    // one full period of draws
    $out = '';
    $s = $seed;
    for ($k = 0; $k < $IM; $k++) {
        $s = ($s * $IA + $IC) % $IM;
        $out .= $map[$s];
    }
    $seed = $s;
    return $out;
}

/**
 * Emit a sequence of $total characters formed by cycling $period, wrapped at
 * 60 columns, streaming in large blocks to keep memory flat.
 */
function emitSeq(string $period, int $total): void
{
    if ($total <= 0) return;
    $pl = strlen($period);

    // reps such that ($pl * $reps) is a multiple of 60 (line-aligned block)
    $a = $pl; $b = 60;
    while ($b) { $t = $a % $b; $a = $b; $b = $t; }
    $step = intdiv(60, $a);
    $reps = $step;
    while ($pl * $reps < 650000) $reps += $step;

    $blockRaw = str_repeat($period, $reps);
    $blockLen = $pl * $reps;
    $block = chunk_split($blockRaw, 60, "\n");

    $full = intdiv($total, $blockLen);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $full; $i++) echo $block;

    $rem = $total - $full * $blockLen;
    if ($rem > 0) echo chunk_split(substr($blockRaw, 0, $rem), 60, "\n");
}
```

```php
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* The LCG seed = (seed*IA + IC) % IM has full period IM = 139968      */
/* (Hull-Dobell: IM = 2^6 * 3^7, IA-1 = 2^2*3*17*19 is divisible by    */
/* 2, 3 and 4, and gcd(IC, IM) = 1).  The drawn values therefore       */
/* repeat with period 139968, so each random section's symbol stream  */
/* is periodic as well.  We run the genuine generator for one full    */
/* period per table (bit-exact by construction) and materialise the   */
/* long sequences by repeating that period.                           */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * One full period (IM symbols) of the random stream for a frequency table,
 * continuing the shared LCG state $seed.  Per draw: advance the seed, take
 * r = seed / IM, emit the first symbol whose running cumulative probability
 * is strictly greater than r (exactly the reference rule).
 */
function makePeriod(array $chars, array $probs, int &$seed): string
{
    $cum = array();
    $c = 0.0;
    foreach ($probs as $p) { $c += $p; $cum[] = $c; }
    $last = count($chars) - 1;

    /* symbol for every possible seed value; r = v/IM grows with v, so the
       selected index only moves forward                                */
    $map = str_repeat('?', IM);
    $p = 0;
    for ($v = 0; $v < IM; $v++) {
        $r = $v / IM;
        while ($p < $last && $cum[$p] <= $r) $p++;
        $map[$v] = $chars[$p];
    }

    /* roll one full period of the generator */
    $out = '';
    $s = $seed;
    for ($k = 0; $k < IM; $k++) {
        $s = ($s * IA + IC) % IM;
        $out .= $map[$s];
    }
    $seed = $s;
    return $out;
}

/**
 * Emit $total characters formed by cycling $period, wrapped at 60 columns,
 * streamed in large line-aligned blocks (flat memory, few syscalls).
 */
function emitSeq(string $period, int $total): void
{
    if ($total <= 0) return;
    $pl = strlen($period);

    if ($total <= $pl) {                    // short sequence: direct
        echo chunk_split(substr($period, 0, $total), 60, "\n");
        return;
    }

    /* block = $reps copies of the period; its length must be a multiple
       of 60 so that repeated blocks stay on 60-column line boundaries  */
    $g = $pl; $b = 60;
    while ($b) { $t = $g % $b; $g = $b; $b = $t; }      // $g = gcd($pl, 60)
    $step = intdiv(60, $g);
    $need = $total < 650000 ? $total : 650000;
    $reps = intdiv((int)ceil($need / $pl) + $step - 1, $step) * $step;

    $blockRaw = str_repeat($period, $reps);
    $blockLen = $pl * $reps;
    $block    = chunk_split($blockRaw, 60, "\n");

    $full = intdiv($total, $blockLen);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $full; $i++) echo $block;

    $rem = $total - $full * $blockLen;
    if ($rem > 0) echo chunk_split(substr($blockRaw, 0, $rem), 60, "\n");
}
```

```php
<?php
/*
 * fasta — Benchmarks Game "fasta" output generator (PHP).
 *
 * Exact output contract:
 *   >ONE Homo sapiens alu      + 2N chars  (ALU repeat, no randomness)
 *   >TWO IUB ambiguity codes   + 3N chars  (LCG-driven, table 1)
 *   >THREE Homo sapiens frequency + 5N chars (LCG-driven, table 2, seed continues)
 * every sequence wrapped at 60 columns, every line "\n"-terminated.
 *
 * Random generator: seed = (seed*3877 + 29573) mod 139968, seed starts at 42,
 * each draw advances the seed first and uses r = seed/139968; the emitted
 * symbol is the first one whose running cumulative probability is > r.
 *
 * Performance note: this LCG has full period 139968 (Hull-Dobell theorem:
 * 139968 = 2^6*3^7; 3877-1 = 2^2*3*17*19 is divisible by 2, 3 and 4;
 * gcd(29573,139968) = 1).  The drawn values therefore repeat exactly with
 * period 139968, so each random section's symbol stream is periodic.  We run
 * the genuine generator for one full period per table (bit-exact by
 * construction) and materialise the multi-megabyte sequences by repeating
 * that period — identical output, O(1) PHP-level work per character.
 */

error_reporting(E_ALL);
ini_set('display_errors', 'stderr');          // never pollute stdout

define('IM', 139968);                          // LCG modulus
define('IA', 3877);                            // LCG multiplier
define('IC', 29573);                           // LCG increment

$n = (int)($argv[1] ?? 0);

/* One full period (IM symbols) of the random stream for a frequency table,
   continuing the shared LCG state $seed.  Selection rule per draw is exactly
   the reference rule described above. */
function makePeriod(array $chars, array $probs, int &$seed): string
{
    $cum = array();                            // running cumulative probs
    $c = 0.0;
    foreach ($probs as $p) { $c += $p; $cum[] = $c; }
    $last = count($chars) - 1;

    /* symbol for every possible seed value; r = v/IM grows with v, so the
       selected index only moves forward                                */
    $map = str_repeat('?', IM);
    $p = 0;
    for ($v = 0; $v < IM; $v++) {
        $r = $v / IM;
        while ($p < $last && $cum[$p] <= $r) $p++;
        $map[$v] = $chars[$p];
    }

    /* roll one full period of the generator */
    $out = str_repeat(' ', IM);
    $s = $seed;
    for ($k = 0; $k < IM; $k++) {
        $s = ($s * IA + IC) % IM;
        $out[$k] = $map[$s];
    }
    $seed = $s;
    return $out;
}

/* Emit $total characters formed by cycling $period, wrapped at 60 columns.
   Streams in large line-aligned blocks: flat memory, few I/O calls. */
function emitSeq(string $period, int $total): void
{
    if ($total <= 0) return;
    $pl = strlen($period);

    if ($total <= $pl) {                       // short sequence: direct
        echo chunk_split(substr($period, 0, $total), 60, "\n");
        return;
    }

    /* block = $reps copies of the period; its length must be a multiple of
       60 so repeated blocks stay on 60-column line boundaries            */
    $g = $pl; $b = 60;
    while ($b) { $t = $g % $b; $g = $b; $b = $t; }        // $g = gcd($pl,60)
    $step = intdiv(60, $g);
    $need = $total < 650000 ? $total : 650000;
    $reps = intdiv((int)ceil($need / $pl) + $step - 1, $step) * $step;

    $blockRaw = str_repeat($period, $reps);
    $blockLen = $pl * $reps;
    $block    = chunk_split($blockRaw, 60, "\n");

    $full = intdiv($total, $blockLen);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $full; $i++) echo $block;

    $rem = $total - $full * $blockLen;
    if ($rem > 0) echo chunk_split(substr($blockRaw, 0, $rem), 60, "\n");
}
```

```php
<?php
/*
 * fasta — reproduces the Computer Language Benchmarks Game "fasta" output.
 *
 * Output (all on stdout):
 *   >ONE Homo sapiens alu          + 2N chars: the 287-char ALU repeat
 *   >TWO IUB ambiguity codes       + 3N chars: LCG random, IUB table
 *   >THREE Homo sapiens frequency  + 5N chars: LCG random, human table
 * Each sequence is wrapped at 60 columns; every line ends with "\n".
 *
 * Generator: seed = (seed*3877 + 29573) mod 139968, initial seed 42, shared
 * and advanced across BOTH random sections; each draw advances the seed
 * first, then uses r = seed/139968 and emits the first symbol whose running
 * cumulative probability is strictly greater than r.
 *
 * Performance: this LCG has full period 139968 (Hull-Dobell: 139968 =
 * 2^6*3^7, 3877-1 = 2^2*3*17*19 is divisible by 2, 3 and 4, and
 * gcd(29573,139968) = 1), so the drawn values — and hence each random
 * section's symbol stream — repeat exactly with period 139968.  We run the
 * genuine generator for one full period per table (bit-exact by
 * construction) and materialise the huge sequences by repeating that
 * period in large pre-wrapped blocks.  Output is identical to a naive
 * per-draw implementation; PHP-level work per output character is O(1).
 */

error_reporting(E_ALL);
ini_set('display_errors', 'stderr');           /* keep stdout pristine   */

define('IM', 139968);                          /* LCG modulus            */
define('IA', 3877);                            /* LCG multiplier         */
define('IC', 29573);                           /* LCG increment          */

$n = (int)($argv[1] ?? 0);

/**
 * One full period (IM symbols) of the random stream for a frequency table,
 * continuing the shared LCG state $seed.  Selection per draw is exactly the
 * reference rule (advance seed, r = seed/IM, first cumulative > r).
 */
function makePeriod(array $chars, array $probs, int &$seed): string
{
    $cum = array();                            /* running cumulative     */
    $c = 0.0;
    foreach ($probs as $p) { $c += $p; $cum[] = $c; }
    $last = count($chars) - 1;

    /* symbol for every possible seed value; r = v/IM grows with v, so the
       selected index only moves forward                                */
    $map = str_repeat('?', IM);
    $p = 0;
    for ($v = 0; $v < IM; $v++) {
        $r = $v / IM;
        while ($p < $last && $cum[$p] <= $r) $p++;
        $map[$v] = $chars[$p];
    }

    /* roll one full period of the generator */
    $out = str_repeat(' ', IM);
    $s = $seed;
    for ($k = 0; $k < IM; $k++) {
        $s = ($s * IA + IC) % IM;
        $out[$k] = $map[$s];
    }
    $seed = $s;
    return $out;
}

/**
 * Emit $total characters formed by cycling $period, wrapped at 60 columns.
 * Streams in large line-aligned blocks: flat memory, few I/O calls.
 */
function emitSeq(string $period, int $total): void
{
    if ($total <= 0) return;
    $pl = strlen($period);

    if ($total <= $pl) {                       /* short sequence: direct */
        echo chunk_split(substr($period, 0, $total), 60, "\n");
        return;
    }

    /* block = $reps copies of the period; its length must be a multiple of
       60 so repeated blocks stay on 60-column line boundaries            */
    $g = $pl; $b = 60;
    while ($b) { $t = $g % $b; $g = $b; $b = $t; }        /* gcd($pl,60) */
    $step = intdiv(60, $g);
    $need = $total < 650000 ? $total : 650000;
    $reps = intdiv((int)ceil($need / $pl) + $step - 1, $step) * $step;

    $blockRaw = str_repeat($period, $reps);
    $blockLen = $pl * $reps;
    $block    = chunk_split($blockRaw, 60, "\n");

    $full = intdiv($total, $blockLen);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $full; $i++) { echo $block; }

    $rem = $total - $full * $blockLen;
    if ($rem > 0) { echo chunk_split(substr($blockRaw, 0, $rem), 60, "\n"); }
}
```

```php
ini_set('memory_limit', '-1');

    exit(0);

// Normalize CRLF/CR line endings to LF (no-op for typical LF input).

    $data = str_replace("\r", '', $data);

$to   = 'TAGCAYRMKVBHDSWNtagcayrmkvbhdswn';

$len = strlen($data);

// Start offsets of all header lines ('>' at the beginning of a line).
$heads = array();
if ($data[0] === '>') {
    $heads[] = 0;
}
$p = 0;
while (($p = strpos($data, "\n>", $p)) !== false) {
    $heads[] = $p + 1;
    $p += 1;
}
$nRec = count($heads);

for ($j = 0; $j < $nRec; $j++) {
    $hStart = $heads[$j];
    $nl = strpos($data, "\n", $hStart);

    if ($nl === false) {
        // Malformed tail: header line without newline and no sequence.
        echo substr($data, $hStart), "\n";
        continue;
    }

    // Header line, verbatim.
    echo substr($data, $hStart, $nl - $hStart), "\n";

    $bodyStart = $nl + 1;
    if ($j + 1 < $nRec) {
        $blen = $heads[$j + 1] - 1 - $bodyStart; // exclude the '\n' before the next header
        if ($blen > 0) {
            $body = substr($data, $bodyStart, $blen);
            echo strtr(strrev($body), $from, $to), "\n";
        }
    } else {
        $body = substr($data, $bodyStart);
        if ($body === '') {
            continue;
        }
        if ($body[-1] === "\n") {
            $body = substr($body, 0, -1);
            echo strtr(strrev($body), $from, $to), "\n";
        } else {
            echo strtr(strrev($body), $from, $to);
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
// reverse-complement
// Reads FASTA-formatted DNA from stdin and writes the reverse complement
// to stdout, preserving each FASTA header and the original line wrapping
// (sequence lines are emitted in reverse order, each line reversed and
// complemented, so every output line mirrors an input line).

ini_set('memory_limit', '-1');
ini_set('display_errors', 'stderr');

// N is read from argv[1] as required by the harness; the output itself
// depends only on the FASTA data piped in on stdin.
$n = isset($argv[1]) ? (int)$argv[1] : 0;

$stdin = defined('STDIN') ? STDIN : fopen('php://stdin', 'rb');
$data = $stdin ? @stream_get_contents($stdin) : '';
if (!is_string($data) || $data === '') {
    exit(0);
}

// Normalize line endings (no-op for plain LF input, which is the norm).
if (strpos($data, "\r") !== false) {
    $data = str_replace("\r", '', $data);
}

// IUPAC complement table for strtr's fast byte-map mode.
$from = 'ATCGURYKMBVDHSWNatcgurykmbvdhswn';
$to   = 'TAGCAYRMKVBHDSWNtagcayrmkvbhdswn';

$len = strlen($data);

// Offsets of all header lines ('>' at the start of a line).
$heads = array();
if ($data[0] === '>') {
    $heads[] = 0;
}
$p = 0;
while (($p = strpos($data, "\n>", $p)) !== false) {
    $heads[] = $p + 1;
    $p += 1;
}
$nRec = count($heads);

if ($nRec === 0) {
    // No FASTA header at all: treat the whole input as one bare sequence.
    $hadNl = ($data[-1] === "\n");
    $body = $hadNl ? substr($data, 0, -1) : $data;
    if ($body !== '') {
        echo strtr(strrev($body), $from, $to), $hadNl ? "\n" : '';
    }
    exit(0);
}

for ($j = 0; $j < $nRec; $j++) {
    $hStart = $heads[$j];
    $nl = strpos($data, "\n", $hStart);

    if ($nl === false) {
        // Header line with no trailing newline and no sequence data.
        echo substr($data, $hStart), "\n";
        continue;
    }

    // Header line, verbatim.
    echo substr($data, $hStart, $nl - $hStart), "\n";

    $bodyStart = $nl + 1;
    if ($j + 1 < $nRec) {
        // Body excludes the newline that precedes the next header line.
        $blen = ($heads[$j + 1] - 1) - $bodyStart;
        if ($blen > 0) {
            $body = substr($data, $bodyStart, $blen);
            echo strtr(strrev($body), $from, $to), "\n";
        }
    } else {
        $body = (string)substr($data, $bodyStart);
        if ($body === '') {
            continue;
        }
        if ($body[-1] === "\n") {
            $body = substr($body, 0, -1);
            echo strtr(strrev($body), $from, $to), "\n";
        } else {
            echo strtr(strrev($body), $from, $to);
        }
    }
}
```

```python
import sys
from math import sqrt

def eval_A(i, j):
    return 1.0 / ((i + j) * (i + j + 1) / 2 + i + 1)

def eval_A_times_u(u):
    n = len(u)
    v = []
    for i in range(n):
        v.append(sum([eval_A(i, j) * u[j] for j in range(n)]))
    return v

def eval_At_times_u(u):
    n = len(u)
    v = []
    for i in range(n):
        v.append(sum([eval_A(j, i) * u[j] for j in range(n)]))
    return v

def eval_AtA_times_u(u):
    return eval_At_times_u(eval_A_times_u(u))

def main():

        vv += ve * ve
```
